resultText:
No critical ambiguities detected worth formal clarification, so I asked no questions and left `spec.md` unchanged.

- **Questions asked and answered**: 0.
- **Spec**: `specs/002-prevent-booking-overlap/spec.md`, no sections touched.
- **Spec Quality Checklist**: 16/16 → 16/16 items passing; nothing changed state.
- **Extension hooks**: `.specify/extensions.yml` does not exist, so none were run before or after.
- **Branch**: the prerequisites script reports the feature as `002-prevent-booking-overlap`, but the work is on `main`, as the spec itself states.

| Category | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Functional scope and behaviour | Clear | Four prioritised stories; FR-020 to FR-022 bound the scope. |
| Domain and data model | Clear | Half-open spans, same-room scope, deleted bookings and confirmation state are all settled. |
| Interaction and UX flow | Clear | Message placement, kept input and when the message disappears are specified. |
| Non-functional quality | Outstanding (low impact) | No latency or throughput target for the overlap check; correctness under races is measurable through SC-003. |
| Integration and dependencies | Clear | One contract change (the new error code); no new dependency. |
| Edge cases and failure handling | Clear | Check order, idempotency-key reuse, replays and update/create/delete races are covered. |
| Constraints and tradeoffs | Deferred | How overlap is detected and how simultaneous requests are serialised is an implementation choice for `/speckit-plan`. |
| Terminology | Clear | "Span", "overlap" and "overlap rejection" are used consistently. |
| Completion signals | Clear | FR-023 to FR-025 and SC-001 to SC-007 are testable. |
| Placeholders | Clear | No TODO markers or unquantified adjectives. |

The spec's Assumptions section already records the points the description left open (overlap checked last, updates included in the race guarantee, a rejected create leaving its key reusable). If any of those readings is wrong, change it before planning.

I recommend proceeding; the one Outstanding item would not change the design or the tests.

Suggested next command: `/speckit-plan`
